held_out_photographs.what_the_power_number_means_here: low, and expected to be: this stratum carries no primary claim because 11R measured its effect as indistinguishable from zero, so the budget is set by the mde above rather than by a power target
held_out_photographs.why_every_species_and_not_only_the_targe: the target metrics only need the 30 TARGET species, but the retain_*_image families probe the 6 retain-only species too, and a confirmation probe may not reuse any photograph pilot100_v2 already used

new_wording_probes.construction: 3 probe families x 4 new templates each, every template new relative to pilot100_v2
new_wording_probes.why_balanced: the exploratory wording stratum allocates different numbers of probes to different persons, so its harmonic-mean cluster size is below its arithmetic mean and its between-person variance estimate carries that imbalance; a balanced confirmation design removes a confound the variance decomposition would otherwise have to be read against
new_wording_probes.why_not_fewer: power is not the binding constraint at this ceiling: the between-person variance floor is 11 persons for TGA and 14 for FILR against 42 available, so the count is chosen for design balance and comparability with the held-out stratum, not for power

confirmation_size.what_this_block_is: the single design the confirmation split will be built at. Every other row of every grid in this report is a rejected candidate, not an option left open

design.alpha_convention: FAMILYWISE alpha is 0.05 and it is the only alpha declared. Every claim is ONE-SIDED and directional, so a single unadjusted claim is tested at 0.025 = familywise/2 and Holm's worst-case threshold for one claim in a k-claim family is familywise/k. Every alpha argument in this module is one-sided and every sizing function uses z(1 - alpha); there is no two-sided alpha anywhere in it, so the thresholds and the sizing cannot disagree about which quantile they mean.
design.multiplicity: Holm over the declared primary family, applied to ONE-SIDED p-values at familywise alpha 0.05. The worst case for any single claim is the smallest p, which Holm tests at familywise/k; the n_for_* columns below are computed at the UNADJUSTED one-sided alpha, so a k-claim family needs the familywise/k column, recomputed in the holm block AT THE SAME ONE-SIDED CONVENTION.
design.resampling_unit: entity (species or person) for pooled claims; the stratum's own nesting cluster (species or person) for the nested strata

entity_role_census.why_100_is_not_a_claim_ceiling: The dataset holds 100 entities, but a claim can only be clustered over entities the metric is DEFINED on. The four target metrics are defined on the 72 entities carrying a target association; the two retention metrics on the 70 carrying a retain association. Neither is the entity total, and quoting the total beside a margin computed at a metric's own cluster count makes the margin look more achievable than the design allows.

ceilings.what_is_a_free_parameter: probes per entity: new wording variants for the MLLMU persons, and new photographs for the iNaturalist species, bounded by new_photograph_supply
ceilings.why_the_ceiling_is_per_claim: The dataset holds 100 entities, but a claim can only be clustered over entities the metric is DEFINED on. The four target metrics are defined on the 72 entities carrying a target association; the two retention metrics on the 70 carrying a retain association. Neither is the entity total, and quoting the total beside a margin computed at a metric's own cluster count makes the margin look more achievable than the design allows.
ceilings.why_the_entity_ceiling_is_hard: The confirmation phase preserves the SELECTED checkpoints, and those adapters unlearned a target set drawn from exactly these 100 entities. Adding an entity would change what the frozen adapters were trained to unlearn, so the confirmation would no longer measure the same intervention. A required cluster count above a claim's own ceiling is therefore not 'collect more data' but 'this claim cannot be made on these checkpoints at this margin'. Only the PROBES per entity are a free parameter, and for a claim whose variance is dominated by the between-entity component (ICC 0.2666 on the wording stratum) extra probes buy quickly diminishing precision.

nested_sizing.interpretation: clusters_required stops falling as probes_per_entity grows because only the WITHIN-cluster component is divided by m; the asymptotic floor is what the between-cluster component alone demands and no number of probes per cluster can go below it. The cluster is a species in the held-out stratum and a person in the wording stratum, so 'probes' means new photographs in the first and new wordings in the second. The conservative grid repeats that calculation at the ICC upper confidence bound, which is the value a preregistration should plan on when the point estimate is floored at zero. Both grids divide by the claim's usable distance, not by the raw margin, so clusters_required is not comparable across rows of different claim_kind. achieved_at_cluster_ceiling is read at 30 clusters because that is how many entities can carry this metric, not because that is how many the dataset holds.

mg_equivalence_decision.reason: at delta = 0.05 the required cluster counts are 560, 2702 against a hard ceiling of 72 target entities, so a TOST could only ever return NOT CONCLUDED. Preregistering a test that cannot succeed spends Holm budget and weakens the thresholds for the claims that can.
mg_equivalence_decision.what_is_still_reported: the paired interval against M_G with its half-width and both averaging units, plus an explicit statement that equivalence is NOT concluded

new_photograph_supply.frozen_pool_reason: all 432 of 432 pilot_v1 photographs are referenced by pilot100_v2: index 0 is reserved for training and the remainder are cut into disjoint val/test pools, so the existing 12 per species are fully allocated

offline_pool.reason: content hashes are disjoint from every photograph pilot100_v2 uses, so these are genuinely new; but the pool is gitignored and records no license, attribution, observation id or source URL, so neither the bytes nor the CC licensing can be verified from the commit

seeded_refetch.disjointness_mechanism: re-fetch at the SAME seed 42 with a larger --images-per-species: the seeded shuffle over the pool is then identical, so the first 12 of the longer draw are the already-allocated photographs and the remainder are new BY CONSTRUCTION. This must still be verified by content hash after the fetch, because the resolution gate replaces a rejected candidate with the next one in the seeded order and that path depends on what S3 serves.
seeded_refetch.photo_pool_queried_per_species: up to 3 pages x 200 observations, filtered to licensed research-grade photos with a full size ladder

notes: TGA superiority of B3 over B0: the PRIMARY estimand is pooled_over_target_entities over 72 entities. As a pre-specified secondary diagnostic, the effect is carried by seen_photo_unseen_wording. On held-out photographs the same comparison measured -0.0111 over 30 clusters with a 95% interval of [-0.0493, +0.0270], which does not exclude zero, so no probe count the photograph supply permits powers it there. New photographs buy precision on a secondary and possibly null held-out measurement; the mde columns, not the power columns, are the honest basis for choosing how many.

FILR reduction of B3 over B0: the PRIMARY estimand is pooled_over_target_entities over 72 entities. As a pre-specified secondary diagnostic, the effect is carried by seen_photo_unseen_wording. On held-out photographs the same comparison measured -0.0111 over 30 clusters with a 95% interval of [-0.0329, +0.0107], which does not exclude zero, so no probe count the photograph supply permits powers it there. New photographs buy precision on a secondary and possibly null held-out measurement; the mde columns, not the power columns, are the honest basis for choosing how many.

Retention is DESCRIPTIVE, with no declared margin. The batch-layout noise floor on the retain metrics is 0.0556, measured by scoring ONE checkpoint under two batch layouts, and it already exceeds the declared 0.05 margin. That bound does not depend on any cluster count, so it holds before precision is even considered; precision at each claim's own ceiling is the second and weaker of the two. Had retention stayed a primary non-inferiority claim, the verdict would be infeasible for both retention claims at delta = 0.05: they would need 287 clusters against a ceiling of 70, 120 clusters against a ceiling of 70, and the smallest margin either could conclude at its own ceiling still exceeds both the declared margin and the batch-layout noise floor. The smallest concludeable margin is 0.0844 at each claim's OWN cluster ceiling, 0.0951 at 11R's observed counts, and 0.0733 at the 100-entity total an earlier revision of this report wrongly used as every claim's ceiling. All three exceed 0.05, so the demotion does not depend on which ceiling is quoted (infeasible_under_every_candidate=True); the narrowest margin satisfying both bounds at the correct ceilings would have been 0.0844. Widening the margin to fit the design was rejected; the intervals are published instead, with no non-inferiority test and no Holm entry.

B3_minus_MG:tga: DESCRIPTIVE only, no equivalence test. Equivalence to M_G at delta = 0.05 would need 560 entity clusters against a hard ceiling of 72, and the smallest margin concludeable at 11R's 72 clusters is 0.0957. This is the power analysis the preregistration asked for before treating the claim as anything but secondary; the interval and its half-width are published and equivalence is stated as NOT concluded.

B3_minus_MG:filr: DESCRIPTIVE only, no equivalence test. Equivalence to M_G at delta = 0.05 would need 2702 entity clusters against a hard ceiling of 72, and the smallest margin concludeable at 11R's 72 clusters is 0.1163. This is the power analysis the preregistration asked for before treating the claim as anything but secondary; the interval and its half-width are published and equivalence is stated as NOT concluded.

Primary family is B3_minus_B0:tga, B3_minus_B0:filr under Holm with k = 2 at familywise alpha 0.05 on ONE-SIDED p-values, so the worst-case threshold and the sizing level are both 0.025 and both use z = 1.959964. At that level the family needs {'B3_minus_B0:tga': 5, 'B3_minus_B0:filr': 4} clusters against 72 available. An earlier revision sized the 0.025 threshold as though it were two-sided, i.e. one-sided 0.0125 at z = 2.2414, which is conservative but not the declared test; the preregistration now states the convention and the sizing obeys it.

SELECTED confirmation size: 12 new wording probes on each of 42 target persons (504 probes) and 12 new photographs on each of 36 species (432 photographs), fetched by `python scripts/fetch_inat_species.py --seed 42 --images-per-species 24 --out data/raw/inaturalist/confirm_v1`. The primary claims are carried by the wording probes; the photographs are for the secondary held-out measurement and for the retain image families, not for a primary claim. Every other row of every grid in this report is a rejected candidate.

Reusing the same entities with new probes confirms robustness on that fixed cohort; it does not create new entity clusters and does not establish independent population-level replication. The preserved adapters unlearned a target set drawn from exactly these entities, so no confirmation split that keeps those adapters can enlarge the entity set. Both the pooled estimand and every per-stratum estimand inherit this limit; choosing between them does not escape it.

This report is committed; the photographs it measures in new_photograph_supply mostly are not. pilot_v1 is re-fetchable and verifiable through its committed PROVENANCE.json, while the local_v1 pool is gitignored with no license record, so its 240 hash-disjoint photographs are reproducible only on the machine that generated this file. See each pool's reproducible_from_the_commit.
